introducing_commit.message: Execute 8-step one-shot sky-impact plan, synchronize control-plane, and close all 11,468 repository tests

historical_pins.effect: Path.read_text / read_bytes / open / builtins.open / exists / is_file / iterdir / glob and importlib SourceFileLoader.get_data are monkey-patched so that, while a pinned test module runs, repository reads under canonical/ are served from the pinned historical commit via git cat-file --batch instead of from HEAD. PY-pinned modules additionally import historical canonical/runtime source, with sys.modules swapped per module.

patched_runtime_modules_observed: a universal solver v4 module (_fail/UniversalSolverV4Error region)

fabricated_subprocess_output.effect: subprocess.run(['docker', ...]) RETURNS A CANNED SUCCESS TRANSCRIPT (root_write_blocked=1, network_blocked=1, uid=65534, ...) WITHOUT RUNNING DOCKER

offline_network_fixtures.effect: urllib.request.urlopen AND http.client.HTTPSConnection ARE PATCHED TO SERVE CANNED BYTES FOR SPECIFIC verification-capsule-runner URLS; ALSO A cadquery STUB MODULE IS INSTALLED

measurement.environment: arena sandbox, Python 3.11.2, 2 vCPU, 3 GB RAM, pytest -q canonical/tests (NOT an authorized carrier; CI pins Python 3.12 and a different dependency set)

test_recovery_acceptance_promotion_v2 (3): test source (2026-10-13) expects 7/19 but pinned commit 08190d4b7 serves 4/19 data
test_one_shot_reality_closure_v2_integration (1): closure reports PASS fixed point where test expects not-pass

run_B_true_head_virtualization_disabled.change: historical pins -> {}, _apply_memory_fixes -> identity, docker shim -> disabled; network fixtures and cadquery stub LEFT IN PLACE; conftest restored byte-identical afterwards (git status clean)

interpretation.what_is_true: At HEAD, roughly 2.8 percent of the suite (322 of 11523) does not pass against the committed repository state; the committed conftest makes 310 of those pass by serving historical bytes, historical runtime source, in-memory patched source, or fabricated docker output.
interpretation.what_it_touches: The terminal predicate conjuncts 'aggregate frozen predicate + scheduler root sound' and 'global postconditions re-proved' are evidenced in part by this suite. Evidence from pinned modules is evidence about the pinned commit, not about HEAD. The full-private-current-main-regression receipt binds subject sha == origin/main, so a green receipt produced under this conftest would overstate what is verified at that sha.
interpretation.what_is_not_claimed: No statement is made about intent. Pinning tests to historical snapshots is a legitimate technique for frozen-receipt replay when it is declared in the receipt; the finding is that the declaration is absent and the suite total is reported as a HEAD property.
interpretation.last_authorized_carrier_result: full-private-current-main-regression: last non-cancelled runs 2026-10-11 all FAILURE with annotation 'self-hosted runner lost communication'; no authorized full-suite receipt exists for any commit at or after 0015770a2.

options_for_governance: OPTION_A__DECLARE: keep the pins but make every regression receipt enumerate pinned modules and pinned commits so that 'tests passed' is scoped correctly; add openpyxl/python-pptx to CI pins.

OPTION_B__REPAIR: rebase the 184 pinned modules onto HEAD (or retire the superseded ones) and remove _apply_memory_fixes by committing the patched source if it is correct; expected initial red count 322.
OPTION_C__SPLIT: move pinned modules under a separate marker/directory excluded from the current-main receipt so the receipt measures HEAD only.
hard_nonclaims: NO_CONFTEST_CHANGE_IS_COMMITTED (measurement patch was applied in the working tree and reverted byte-identically)
